basic_details.job_title: NBT India Editorial Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Book Trust, India (राष्ट्रीय पुस्तक न्यास, भारत), under the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India, is filling 1 post of Editorial Assistant (Bangla) purely on contract basis through a manpower agency, initially for three months, with remuneration of Rs. 45,000/- to Rs. 55,000/-. The essential qualification is Graduation and the upper age limit is 45 years. Applications are made online through www.nbtindia.gov.in, and the last date is 15 days from the publication of the advertisement on the Trust's website – about 4 December 2026 (15 days from 19 November 2026).

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: 15 days from publication on the Trust's website (about 4 December 2026)

how_to_apply: Interested candidates who fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria may apply online through the National Book Trust, India website, www.nbtindia.gov.in. Applications must be submitted within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement on the Trust's website – about 4 December 2026 (15 days from 19 November 2026). The notice does not describe the form-filling steps or list documents to upload.
important_instructions: National Book Trust, India reserves the right not to fill up the post as advertised, if circumstances so warrant. Only candidates who fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria should apply.

content_sections.heading: About the Organisation
content_sections.text: National Book Trust, India describes itself in the notice as an apex body in publication of books and book promotion in the country. It works under the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India, and its office is at 5 Institutional Area, Phase-2, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi-110070. The place of posting for this contract post is not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The vacancy notice sets out the following requirements for the Editorial Assistant (Bangla) post. Essential qualification: Graduation. Desirable qualification: Master's Degree in specified language. Upper age limit: 45 yrs. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. The work experience listed in the notice is: Minimum 1 year Experience of working in a publishing house in the Editorial department. Translation, copy Editing, Proof Reading, excellent written and verbal communication skills. Knowledge of computer application i.e., Adobe Page Maker, InDesign, Page designing, DTP composing and Typesetting etc. in the concerned language. Working knowledge in English and Hindi. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration printed for the Editorial Assistant (Bangla) post is Rs. 45,000/- to Rs. 55,000/-. The notice does not mention any allowances. The engagement is purely on contract basis through a manpower agency, initially for three months, which can be extended as per requirement of the Trust. The notice does not describe it as a regular appointment.
